name: Grilled Sardines
description:
Three small sardines arrive blistered from the grill with salt and a wedge of sour fruit. Heads and bones are included in the serving; the flesh lifts away in narrow strips.

Sold as one plate of three small sardines. Price and weight cover the food only; serving ware stays with the inn. Unlisted sides and drinks are separate.
saleUnit: One plate of three small sardines

weight.notes: Ready-to-eat portion, including bones or shells where stated for one complete sale unit; adjusted for Variant Encumbrance. The inn's serving vessel and cutlery are excluded.

name: Mussels in Cider
description:
Mussels are steamed in dry cider with chopped onion until the shells open. The cooking liquor stays in the serving bowl; bread for dipping is a separate order.

Sold as one 1 lb bowl of mussels with shells and broth. Price and weight cover the food only; serving ware stays with the inn. Unlisted sides and drinks are separate.

name: Baked Haddock
description:
A haddock fillet is baked beneath a thin crust of oats and mustard. The crust keeps the flesh moist without turning the serving into a full supper plate.

Sold as one 0.5 lb fish portion. Price and weight cover the food only; serving ware stays with the inn. Unlisted sides and drinks are separate.
